message.content:
**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Section | What you need to know | |---------|-----------------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or whatever house rule you set). Points are tallied from the cards left in opponents’ hands when you finish a round. | | **Players** | 2–10 (standard deck). | | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue) × 25 cards each (one 0, two 1–9, two “Skip”, two “Reverse”, two “Draw Two”) + 4 “Wild” + 4 “Wild Draw Four”. | | **Setup** | • Shuffle the deck.
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining cards face‑down as the draw pile.
• Turn the top card of the draw pile face‑up to start the discard pile. If it’s a special card, apply its effect immediately (e.g., if it’s a “Draw Two”, the first player draws two and loses a turn). | | **Turn Order** | Players sit in a circle. The first turn goes clockwise; a “Reverse” card flips the direction. | | **Playing a Card** | On your turn you may play **one** card that matches either the **color** or the **number/symbol** of the top discard. If you have a Wild card, you may play it at any time and declare the new color. | | **Special Cards** | 1. **Skip** – next player loses a turn.
2. **Reverse** – changes play direction.
3. **Draw Two** – next player draws two cards and loses a turn.
4. **Wild** – you choose the new color.
5. **Wild Draw Four** – you choose the new color; next player draws four cards and loses a turn. (Can only be played if you have no matching color; otherwise you risk being challenged.) | | **Drawing** | If you cannot play a card, you must draw one from the draw pile. If that card can be played, you may play it immediately; otherwise your turn ends. | | **UNO Call** | When you have **exactly one card left**, you must shout “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. If you forget and another player catches you, you must draw two penalty cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The round ends when a player discards their last card. That player scores points equal to the sum of the values of all cards still held by the other players: numbers = face value, Skip/Reverse/Draw Two = 20, Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50. | | **Winning the Game** | First player to reach the target score (commonly 500) wins. You can also play a “short‑game” to a lower score or simply play until a single player wins a round. | | **House Rules (optional)** | • **Stacking** – allow players to stack Draw Two or Wild Draw Four cards instead of drawing.
• **No “Wild Draw Four” challenge** – play it freely.
• **“Draw Two” penalty** – next player draws two and loses a turn.
• **“Skip” penalty** – next player loses a turn.
• **“Reverse” on two players** – acts like a Skip. | --- ### Quick Play‑through Example 1. **Deal**: Each player gets 7 cards. 2. **Start**: Top card of discard pile is a Red 5. 3. **Player A** (clockwise) has a Red 9 → plays it. 4. **Player B** has a Green 9 → plays it. 5. **Player C** has a Yellow 9 → plays it. 6. **Player D** has a “Draw Two” (Green) → plays it. Player A draws two cards and loses a turn. 7. **Player B** continues, etc. --- ### Tips for New Players - **Keep track of colors**: If you’re low on a particular color, try to play a Wild to change the color to something you have more of. - **Watch the discard pile**: If someone plays a “Wild Draw Four,” you can challenge them if you suspect they had a matching color. - **UNO call**: Practice saying “UNO!” loudly and clearly—missing it costs you two cards. Enjoy the fast‑paced, colorful fun of Uno!
